targets.summary: Rather than adding a new test, extend the dtype for-loop in the existing test above to cover the new case.
targets.evidence: Before review, the code added a separate test: `def test_repeat_interleave_cpu_small_integer_repeats(self, device):` (marked `@onlyCPU`), which looped over `(torch.int8, torch.uint8, torch.int16)`. The merged code deletes that test and extends the dtype loop in the test above instead: `repeat_dtypes = [torch.int, torch.long]` / `if device == "cpu": repeat_dtypes.extend([torch.int8, torch.uint8, torch.int16])` / `for dtype in repeat_dtypes:`. This is what the maintainer asked for.
